parsed.explanation: The quote appears verbatim in Case k≥1, subcase μ>τ, the main branch of the lower-bound induction. Two defects are real. (i) D_rest is never defined: the text only introduces "R' is R optionally enlarged by a virtual complementary piece", with a parenthetical assertion, and then silently substitutes D_rest. (ii) The needed bound D_rest ≤ μ-1 is not proved; the accompanying clause ("the identity D_rest=μ-1 in the worst case ... which is compatible with ≥1") is circular/garbled, not an argument. Moreover the padding step is inconsistent and unjustified: d is defined both as S_{n-1}-(S_n-μ)=μ-2^n and as μ-τ=μ-2^{n-1}, and P∪R plus an arbitrary dummy need not be a refinement of the bins B_{n-1} required by the induction hypothesis. Nothing elsewhere repairs this: the text falls back on "numerical checks for n≤3". Hence obligation (L) fails for general n.
